svg.title: FL volume across equal-area tetrahedron shapes at fixed J
svg.desc: Heatmap samples over ordered closed equal-area four-face configurations. Miniature reconstructed tetrahedra below and beside both panels show the x and bending-angle coordinate slices.
svg.text: FL positive volume across tetrahedron shapes at J=2
Equal face-area ratios; 440 ordered samples; project-normalized values
